messages:
oliver_marketing: Quick ops for Tuesday 11am PT webinar "Inference at scale: Cost & latency tradeoffs" — need final runbook: registration page, Zoom config, recording + captions, post-event routing. Who owns replay + clips?

maria_ops: I'll own reg page + confirmation email. Planning an A/B CTA test (A: "Register for live", B: "Get recording & slides"). Add UTM params utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=broadcast. HubSpot form mapping ready, will include GDPR consent. Need copy for confirmation email.

jamal_grows: I'll own lead routing — tag all leads with `webinar_bench_Tue317`. HubSpot -> SFDC mapping: Owner -> Queue 'Inbound-webinar', LeadStatus -> MQL. Start 4-day nurture sequence. Publish replay -> AE assignment: round-robin. CC @ben_devrel for clips.

sophia_prod: Zoom setup: cloud recording enabled + audio transcript (SRT). Also record locally on host as backup. Enable captions. Provision RTMP fallback in case cloud fails. Speakers in greenroom 30m before. Run-of-show to be shared.

ben_devrel: I'll handle clips and developer-facing snippets. Need raw mp4 + srt + timestamps. Speakers: please record a 30s intro soundbite. Can we add `?clip=true` to postflow to auto-tag clip requests for pipeline?

maria_ops: HubSpot hidden fields snippet for the reg page:

`````
<!-- hidden fields -->
<input type='hidden' name='utm_source' value='twitter' />
<input type='hidden' name='campaign' value='benchmark_mar2026' />
`````

Also: require GDPR checkbox text: "I agree to receive marketing emails from Redwood Inference" (link to privacy policy). Detect timezone and show local start time.

oliver_marketing: Run-of-show link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcDEF -- speakers: @anna, @kevin. Who will publish the replay? @jamal_grows? :eyes:?

jamal_grows: I'll publish replay within 6 hours and create 3 short clips by EOD. Need SRT + timestamped highlight sheet from production.

zoom-bot: Zoom meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 Passcode: Redwood! Recording: cloud enabled. Transcript: enabled. Meeting ID: 1234567890

sophia_prod: :thumbsup: I'll verify retention settings and run local backup script: `./backup_recording.sh /tmp/zoom1234` before ending meeting.

maria_ops: :lock: Confirmation email subject: "Thanks for registering — Webinar replay & slides". Also adding follow-up to include slides + CTA to request demo. Set HubSpot form to send SmartList tag `webinar_benchmark_2026`.

oliver_marketing: Great — I'll compile the final checklist and ping speakers with greenroom time. :party-parrot:
